description: This file defines the 'LengthClass' controller within the OpenCart admin localisation namespace. It provides functionalities to list, add, edit, and delete length measurement units used in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class manages CRUD operations, handles HTTP GET and POST requests, sets up view data, and interacts with the underlying model for length classes.

classes.name: LengthClass
classes.description: Controller class for managing length measurement units in the OpenCart admin panel. Supports listing, creating, editing, and deleting length classes with pagination and sorting features.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of length classes, handle sorting, ordering, and pagination, and prepare data for the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the data retrieval and output for the length classes list, including sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Constructs and returns the HTML view with current list data, including sorting links, pagination, and table entries.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a length class, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing length class based on submitted form data, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected length classes after permission validation.
